dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'C' and 'O' shaped structures are visible; a prominent elliptical ring in the mid-body displays a sharp dark posterior edge transitioning into a light grey-blue interior, while several smaller closed-loop 'O' geometries appear near the distal end with well-defined high-contrast perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of bright white pixel clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and the far right posterior section; these clusters lack internal gradients and contrast sharply with adjacent low-intensity black voids located between the ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral rings form a primary scalene triangular relationship, with the vertex at the mid-dorsal annulus and the base extending toward the lower mid-body and posterior clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct 'shattered' texture composed of fragmented high-intensity pixel strands is present on the rightmost lateral section, contrasting with the more coherent circular annuli found on the central torso.
